subject: Term negotiation playbook & stakeholder slotting — timelines and QBR availability
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@acme-analytics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Term negotiation playbook & stakeholder slotting — timelines and QBR availability

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the candid renewal conversation last week. We want to get a compact, low-friction plan in motion so legal and procurement at Acme have everything they need, and your engineering team has clear runway for the capacity increase. This thread captures the playbook we propose and the immediate asks to keep timelines tight.

High-level goals:
- Confirm term change to 12 months (from rolling 6) with a staged capacity uplift across Q3–Q4.
- Lock pricing band/discount based on the new commit tiers.
- Schedule a short QBR to align execs and ops, and to surface any security or procurement blockers.

Immediate next steps (what we need from Acme by end of next week):
1) A single point of contact for procurement/legal redlines (name + email).
2) Confirmation of target start-of-term date (proposed: 2028-09-01).
3) Preferred QBR windows (see two options below).

Proposed QBR slots (30–40 min):
- Option A: Tue 2028-07-26 10:00–10:40 PT
- Option B: Thu 2028-07-28 13:00–13:40 PT
Please reply with preferred slot or propose alternatives.

Attachments I’m dropping here: acme_term_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook with milestones and owner map) and capacity_estimate_2028Q3.xlsx (detailed throughput/heads forecast). I’ll highlight the key pages in the next message.

If it helps, Priyom and Karthik are copied — Priyom will lead pricing and deal ops, and Karthik will coordinate capacity/runbook deliverables.

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below:
- Procurement contact: Melissa Hart (melissa.hart@acme-analytics.com). She’s handling legal redlines.
- Target start-of-term: we are aligned on 2028-09-01 pending legal review.
- QBR: Option A (Tue 2028-07-26 10:00 PT) works for execs; we’ll bring our Head of Infra (Tom) and Melissa if available.

Two asks from our side before QBR:
1) A short summary of ’must-have’ SLAs and fallback behavior during capacity bursts (1 page).
2) A clean redline-ready template of the proposed term amendment (we’ll feed into legal).

Can you confirm those two artifacts will be available by EOD 2028-07-24?

Thanks,
Sarah

Subject: Re: Term negotiation playbook & stakeholder slotting — timelines and QBR availability

Sarah — great, locking in Option A (Tue 07/26 10:00 PT). I’ve updated the shared playbook with a one-page SLA/fallback summary (see attached, page 2 of acme_term_playbook_v1.pdf) and uploaded a clean term amendment template to the Drive link in metadata.

Confirming commitments from our side:
- Pricing redline-ready document and draft amendment will be with Melissa (and you) by 2028-07-24 EOD. Priyom is leading that and will add a short comment thread explaining discount bands and the rationale.
- Capacity runbook (Karthik) — we’ll provide a 1-page burst handling runbook and the staffing ramp plan by 2028-07-24; the detailed ops-runbook will follow after the QBR.

Short agenda for the QBR (25–30 min):
1) Introductions & goals (3 min)
2) Term amendment summary and timeline to signature (7 min)
3) Capacity uplift plan & burst SLA (7 min)
4) Next steps / owners / legal handoff (8 min)

Attaching the capacity estimate and re-flagging the playbook. If Melissa wants the amendment in DocuSign/SWord template, tell us which format and we’ll deliver.

See you Tue — I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a link to the shared Drive materials.

Best,
Jonas

--
(attachment stubs: capacity_estimate_2028Q3.xlsx, acme_term_playbook_v1.pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-07-25T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing redline notes for ACME-2028-RNW-47

Jonas / Karthik — quick internal note after review of Melissa’s ask and the playbook:

- I drafted the redline-ready amendment (file: ACME_Amendment_Draft_07-25.docx) with three conditional bands: +12% seats, +30% burst capacity, +50% committed tokens. The final discount will be tiered and tied to the committed tokens band.
- I’ll upload the draft to the shared Drive and post a version to the CRM deal record before the QBR.
- We should propose a 45-day signature runway in the QBR to give Acme’s procurement time to loop in SRE and legal.

Action items for this thread: 
- Jonas: send calendar invite and attach the draft amendment for Melissa.
- Karthik: prepare the 1-page burst operations summary slide for the QBR (due 07/24 EOD — note: now prioritized for immediate upload).
- Priyom: finalize DocuSign template and place a stub in the Drive.

If anyone wants to sync 1:1 before the QBR, I’m available Mon/Tue morning.

Thanks,
Priyom
